label: Illustrative data-quality rules over the included synthetic entity records.

rules.name: Registration key completeness
rules.definition: Entity source records with a non-empty registration_key divided by all in-scope source records.

rules.name: Jurisdiction code validity
rules.definition: Entity source records with a jurisdiction in the illustrative allowed-value list divided by all in-scope source records.

rules.name: Registration-key collision exception rate
rules.definition: Repeated registration-key groups that contain an entity-type, jurisdiction or material-name conflict divided by all repeated-key groups. Identical keys across source feeds are expected candidates; this detects conflicting identity groups, not duplicate-match accuracy.

rules.name: Parent-key reference integrity
rules.definition: Non-empty parent_key values that reference a registration key present in the synthetic source set divided by all non-empty parent_key values. Cycle detection is not included.

rules.name: Legal-name completeness
rules.definition: Entity source records with a non-empty legal_name divided by all in-scope source records.
